data.context: In the 2024 report *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this section explains how the researchers labelled computer-implemented invention (CII) patent applications for machine-learning classification. Using IP Australia examiner objections under the manner of manufacture test, it distinguishes applications likely to face a patentable subject matter objection from those likely to be clear, to study differences across jurisdictions and before and after the 2014 court cases in Australia and the US.
